title: Non-Complex Traffic Management Arrangements - Wheatbelt Region (Part 2)
abstract: Part 2 of the Non-Complex Traffic Management Arrangements for the Wheatbelt Region, continuing the Traffic Guidance Scheme (TGS) diagrams from Part 1. Contains additional TGS setups covering remaining scenarios for rural state roads in the Wheatbelt region. Together with Part 1, provides comprehensive coverage of standard traffic management arrangements for rural road environments in Western Australia.
note: Part 2 contains continuation of TGS diagrams from Part 1. These are graphical traffic guidance schemes rather than traditional document sections.

keyRequirements.requirement: Use in conjunction with Part 1 for complete TGS coverage
Apply same compliance requirements as Part 1
